entry: --presentation-stages (default off, independent of existing cost flags)
scope: owner-thread CPU-side wall intervals and allocated bytes, includes nested operations and observation overhead; not exclusive CPU usage, GPU timing, native allocation/residency or complete upload counters
boundaries: Editor BeginPresentation/Present and Player Present after readiness guards; excludes entry JIT and startup/shutdown; pair with unchanged outer --loop-costs to see uncovered boundary overhead
visits: host phase entries, may repeat and include branch bookkeeping; NOT native operation counts
identity: unique sequence; frame hint may repeat after suspend/failure/recovery and is not a GPU source identity
overflow: retain first 64 calls, count every omitted call, never replace with later/faster rows
failures: failed call retained with Completed=false, phases already entered preserved; successful fail-closed native Present is not equivalent to completed host call
headless: opt-in report with zero calls, no graphics services/resources created
recovery: same capture survives native renderer recovery, sequence not reset
safety: no callbacks, GPU waits, new ECS authority, forced GC, native counters or workload changes
acceptance: development evidence only; no timing thresholds altered; raw cold frames retained; not a JIT or upload root-cause proof
